question: Does footnote *1 ('When discharging') make the 1/Quarter monitoring requirement for Cyanide, Total Recoverable and Total Dissolved Solids applicable only during periods or quarters in which Outfall 001 is actually discharging?
source_locator: aztec/final_permit.pdf page 3 section part_i (Cyanide, Total Recoverable and Total Dissolved Solids rows); aztec/final_permit.pdf page 4 footnote *1
semantic_arguments: Both target parameters list monitoring frequency as 1/Quarter (*1)
The permit authorizes intermittent discharge to the lower Animas Ditch subject to NMAC non-perennial/perennial provisions
notes: The target spans tie quarterly monitoring to footnote *1. Different readings of whether monitoring is required only when discharging would change whether monitoring was obligated for a given period (Purpose B) and whether absent quarterly results reflect conditional non-requirement versus missing evidence (Purpose C).
